answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve 1,000 credits for an exclusive capacity slot, establishing a digital dune of non-fungible resource reservations that forces agents to demonstrate unique operational commitment. A verifier monitors the registry for overlapping assignments to prevent double-commitments, ensuring each identity maintains a single harbor within the network. Honest participants risk 1,000 units, while an attacker attempting to deploy 1,000 fakes incurs a 1,000,000 credit penalty. Fraud triggers a 120-day forfeiture, treating each reservation as an orchard of verifiable.
